items.caption: Hidden things blocking your abundance! #fengshui #home #homeorganization #abundance #declutter @vinted
items.transcript: Here are some hidden things that might be blocking your abundance. According to feng shui, the entryway is the main portal where abundance enters your home. So having a blocked front door is definitely a no-no. Make sure to clear out any boxes, shoes, or other clutter from this area. A clear front door allows fresh new energy to flow freely and allows your cats to flow more freely too. Dead or dying plants, which symbolize stagnation, decay, and neglect. So make sure to water your plants regularly and check for any dead leaves. A leaky faucet, which is a classic feng shui symbol for money leaking away. Oh, and make sure to keep those toilet lids closed too. And while we're here, let's bring back the humble bar of hand soap. Broken or neglected items, which are traditionally associated with stuck or depleted energy. As soon as you replace broken appliances, this will restore healthy energy to your home. Objects connected to an old version of your life. Maybe it was a gift from a past relationship or from a period you desperately want to leave behind. Whatever it is, it's important to release the things that no longer support who you're becoming.

items.caption: ADHD-Friendly home hacks that *actually* work! @dyson #dyson #home #homeorganization #adhd
items.transcript: Here are some home hacks if you've got ADHD. Did someone say ADHD? I've got that. Make everything visible. This includes your cleaning tools and your cleaning supplies. I've been using the Dyson Pencil Vac. I love that the LED light makes all of that dust super visible and the charging dock makes everything really accessible so there's no excuse not to vacuum. I also keep my bathroom cleaner out and my kitchen cleaner because when everything is out of sight, it's out of mind and I'm much less likely to clean. Create special stations or zones. This one has been a game changer. So whether it's a tea and coffee station or a cleaning station or even a pet food station, you'll spend less time looking for everything. To get rid of that chronic clutter that affects so many people with ADHD, keep trash cans in almost every room. Don't fold what doesn't need folding. No one has to know. Organize around your actual habits. So if you leave your keys by your coffee station, just put a tray there. You don't have to overthink it.

items.caption: 5 realistic cleaning habits to keep your home tidy 🧼🧺@koalaeco #home #koalaeco #homeorganization #clean #tidy
items.transcript: Here are five realistic cleaning habits to keep your home tidy. This says Sweetie contemplates the meaning of life. Handle the mail right away. I know, I know, everyone's favorite habit. Toss junk mail in a nearby wastebasket and important mail goes at my desk. Make your bed every day. It doesn't have to look perfect, it just has to get done. Because there's nothing better than getting into a made bed. Wipe surfaces every day, especially your bathroom sink to keep the toothpaste gunk at bay. This all-purpose cleaner is so pretty I can just keep it out. And when I say surfaces, I also mean kitchen counters. My grandmother always said never go to bed with dirty kitchen counters. Okay, she didn't say that, but someone's grandmother definitely did. So simple yet effective, do a nightly five-minute reset. That means hanging up everyone's favorite floor clothes. You can hang them on hooks if they're not yet ready to go in the wash, and they're also not yet ready to be hung back up. Put any bags away, put any cats away. This blanket is Sweetie's kryptonite. Wash and put away dishes from some Rice Krispie treats I made earlier. I use automatic dish soap to make washing pots and pans a lot easier. There's something about a dish-free sink that makes life feel better. And speaking of feeling better, don't forget to treat yourself every single day.

items.caption: How to keep your cat happy with @temptationscats #cats #home #cat #cats_of_instagram 😻
items.transcript: Here are five daily habits to keep my cat Sweetie happy. I'll have some daily playtime with this laser toy. This is hands down Sweetie's favorite toy. This is great if you just have one cat. It keeps them active and triggers their hunting instincts. I always end the laser tag with some treats to prevent any frustration. I always try to get in a daily brushing session. This is a great way to bond and connect with your cat. And it of course minimizes hairballs. I'm obsessed with this particular brush because you just press a button and it releases cat fur. So it's nice and hairball free for the next use. I love to swap out Sweetie's water every day. Even if it's full, this will minimize that slimy film that forms and prevents any germs. And not sure about your cat, but Sweetie loves ice cubes in her water. Oh, and she also has to always have her fresh water fountain going. Time for her midday sun. No day would be complete without a little afternoon snack. Sweetie is obsessed with the chicken temptations. And side note, if I'm not home, I'll use my Furbo to release treats and keep Sweetie happy and occupied. And if it's movie night, I'll make sure to whip out Sweetie's favorite blanket. And this one always brings the biscuits. And then when it's bedtime, I always reach for my meow button. And this always brings Sweetie over and it helps us wind down for bed. Okay, mostly wind down.
